header_sentences: See Israel, and Son of God.

contexts.text: The fruits thence, which are truths, are called sons.
Sons = the goods and truths of faith. Illustrated.
Sons = truths of faith.
Sons and daughters = truths and goods. Illustrated.
(Enoch) begat sons and daughters () = doctrinals concerning truths and goods.
Sons and daughters () = the conceptions and births of such a Church.
Sons = the things of the understanding; and, when there is no understanding of truth, phantasies.
Sons of the stranger () = falsities. AE 376:12.
Sons born to them () = doctrinals derived thence.
Sons = truths of faith, also falsities, consequently doctrinals...
The sons of Ham = derivations of doctrinals and worships from corrupt internal worship.
The sons of Shem = things of wisdom. Explained.
The sons of Aram = Knowledges thence.
Begat sons and daughters = doctrinals. AC 1341. AC 1344. ( = doctrinals which are rituals. AC 1346.) ( = rituals. AC 1348. AC 1350. AC 1352. AC 1354.)
Son and daughter = truth and good; in the opposite, falsity and evil.
In Heaven they know not what a son is, but the spiritual state which is relatively as a son.
They live from the Lord's life... and hence are called sons.
Thou shalt bear a son () = the truth, namely of this Rational. AC 1960.
Son, here, = the Lord, who is called Son because He is truth itself, and all truth is from Him.
I will give thee a son from her () = a Rational; (for) son = truth; and, as all the Rational begins from truth, by son is here signified a Rational. AC 2082. AC 2139. AC 2194.
He was no longer the son of Mary.
Sons = all in truths. AC 2232. AC 2390.
He hath given all judgment unto the Son (): the Son means the Divine Human.
Hence the sons of Lot were not saved.
Sons = truths of doctrine.
A son () = the Divine Rational. A son = truth; and as truth is the chief thing in the Rational, son = the Rational... AC 2628. AC 2772.
Sons = truths, here, those in the Rational.
Son () = the truth of the mere human Rational.
The celestial are called heirs... the spiritual, sons.
Isaac is called his son () because the Lord's Divine Human was not only conceived, but was also born from Jehovah.

Thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only one, from Me () = the unition of the Human with the Divine through the last of temptation. Thy son, namely, Isaac, = the Divine Rational, or the Divine Human, for this begins in the Rational. AC 2844.
The sons of the people () = those first initiated into truths.
The Son = the Lord's Divine Human.
The Lord as to the Divine Human is called the Son.
This is My beloved Son () = the Divine Human.
All these were sons of Keturah () = as to doctrinals and worships thence. Sons = truths and doctrinals.
The sons of Abraham () = those in truths from the Lord.
The names of the sons of Ishmael () = the qualities of the doctrinals of the spiritual. AC 3269.
Both the good and the truth in the external man is a son, a son, namely, of the internal man. Explained.
To kiss the Son () = conjunction with the Divine Human by the faith of love. See AC 9309:end.
Lower or derived goods and truths are relatively as daughters and sons. AC 3703:6, Illustrated. AC 3908.
Divine truth is what is called the Son. AC 3704:8.
To the land of the sons of the east () = elevation to the truths of love.
Give me sons () = the desire to have interior truths; interior, because from Rachel.
These general states (of regeneration) are what are designated by these twelve sons. Explained. AC 3926. (See AC 4601:end. AC 4602-4609.)
Hath given me a son () = that this truth was acknowledged. Explained.
A second son to Jacob () = the second general truth.
Zilpah... bore a son to Jacob () = the acknowledgement of external truth. AC 3937. AC 3947.
Leah... bore a sixth son to Jacob () = the reception and acknowledgement of truth.
Gave them into the hand of his sons () = that these things were given to truths.
The words of Laban's sons () = the truths of (that) good.
He lifted up his sons () = the elevation of Truths.
The Son = the Divine truth which is from Divine good.
Kissed his sons and his daughters () = the acknowledgement of these Truths, and of the affections of the same.
Sons (in relation to their mother) = the truths of the Church.
Male children, or sons, = truths. AC 4342. AC 4357. AC 4359. AC 4360. AC 4361. AC 4377. AC 4383.
Sons (of Israel) = truths.
Sons of the kingdom () = those in a vastated Church.
Son, here, = interior truth. AC 4447.
His sons () = his descendants. ( = the truths of faith which belonged to him and his descendants. AC 4441.) AC 4503.
Thou shalt have this son also () = spiritual truth, (because it was Benjamin). AC 4592, Explained.
The king's sons () = truths from the Divine.
All his sons () = those in falsities.
She conceived and bare a son () = falsity of the Church.
She conceived again, and bare a son () = evil which is from falsity.
Again she bare a son () = what is idolatrous.

As marriage represented these things, sons and daughters represented and also signified truths and goods. AC 4843. ( = affections of good and truth, and also the goods and truths which are from the former as parents. AC 5023.)
Sons () = the truths of the Spiritual Kingdom.
This Divine, in Heaven, is the Son.
To Joseph were born two sons () = derivative good and truth.
Jacob said to his sons () = perception concerning truths in general.
Sons of Israel () = spiritual truths.
Sons of one man () = truths from one origin.
The two sons of Reuben () = the two doctrines of the Church, that of truth, and that of good.
Thou, thy sons, and thy sons' sons () = spiritual good... truths in the Natural, and the truths again born and derived.
Whoever loveth son and daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me () = the things which are proper to man by actuality.
The sons of thy father shall bow themselves to thee () = that truths will of themselves submit themselves. Explained.
To bring thy sons from far () = those in truths. ( = truths with the gentiles. AC 6740:end.) AE 242:17. ( = the gentiles who receive truths. AE 294:3.)
The son of a fruitful one () = fructification from truth.
After a son becomes his own master. Explained.
Sons of the thirds = derived things.
Sons, and sons' sons = derived things. AC 7634.
Son = truth. AC 7839. AC 8081. AC 9000. AC 10494. AR 543, Explained, Illustrated. AE 242:16. AE 449:3. AE 724:3.
Every son... ye shall cast into the river () = immerse all truths in falsities.
She bare a son (Moses) = the Law Divine in its origin.
He was unto her as a son () = hence came its first truths.
(Zipporah) bare a son = the truths thence.
My son. My first-born, is Israel () = that those in spiritual truth and good are adopted. Explained.
The son (of Zipporah) = the truth of the representative Church.
The son whom the woman brought forth () = the Divine truth disclosed at this day.
Sons = the truths which are of the Church.
The Only-begotten Son = the Lord as to Divine truth. AC 8573:end. AC 8705:3.
Sons = interior truths of faith.
Sons, here, = goods of truth. Explained. AC 8655. AC 8661.
Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the sons = the prolification of falsity from evil... Sons = falsities.
Nor thy son () = the man's Intellectual... in the internal man.
Sons, here, = falsities.
Son = the truth of faith.
A son of oil () = the external good of love of the celestial Kingdom.
From interior good as a father, and interior truth as a mother, are conceived and born exterior truths and goods, which are therefore called sons and daughters.
The firstborn of the sons = all things of faith of the Church.
Sons () = those within the Church.
Son of a handmaid () = those in the affection of external truth.
The sons of the kingdom, who are the good seed () = the truths of faith of the Church. The sons of the evil kingdom, who are the tares = the falsities of faith of the Church. AC 9807:8. AE 683:6.
The sons of Aaron = Divine truth proceeding from Divine good. Explained. AC 9813. AC 9946. AC 10000. AC 10012.
Sons, in the spiritual sense, are those who are born anew from the Lord, thus those who are in truths from good.
Sons = the things which are born from another as a father; thus the things which proceed.
The Son () = that Divine Itself in a human form. ( = the Divine Human. AE 183:13.)
The derivative Divine truth is as a son.
Sons of delights () = truths Divine. ( = genuine truths of the Church from the Word. AR 47:4.)
His sons = the things which proceed, thus which succeed in order. Explained.
The Son () = the Divine Human. AC 10370:2.
No one Knoweth the Son but the Father (), because by the Son is meant the Divine truth, and by Father the Divine good, both in the Lord, and the one cannot be Known except by the other...

The Divine of the Lord in the lower Heavens is represented by the sons of Aaron... because the lower Heavens are born from the higher ones, as sons from a father. By the lower Heavens are meant the Spiritual Kingdom.
The sons of Aaron = the Lord as to Divine spiritual good. AC 10239.
The sons of a year = the quality of infancy in which truths are implanted.
Sons = truth; in the opposite, falsities.
Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the sons, and upon the sons' sons () = the rejection and damnation of evils and the derivative falsities in a long series.
Sons = truths or falsities; for good is the father of truth, and evil, of falsity.
b. Sons and daughters = the truths and goods which are procreated.
See Son of God.
The Son, alone, after the Lord's Human was glorified, means the Divine Human.
Man cannot be purified if he looks to the Son as a mere man.

I will kill her sons with death () = that all the truths from the Word with them will be turned into falsities... It also signifies to condemn their falsities. ( = that thus falsities are extinguished. AE 166.)
A male son () = the doctrine of the New Church... Or, truth conceived in the spiritual man, and born in the natural. SE 6101:2. SE 6110:28. AE 724.
Whenever the Lord speaks of the Son, He means the Divine truth of the Divine wisdom.
He shall be to Me a son () = that in Heaven they shall be in the Lord, and the Lord in them.
That they who approach the Lord immediately are His sons, is because these have been born anew from Him, and therefore He called His disciples sons. Illustrated.

The offspring from the Lord as a Husband and Father, and from the Church as a wife and mother, are all spiritual, and in the spiritual sense of the Word are meant by sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, etc. Explained.
See Offspring.
The Son whom Mary bore, is the Body of that Divine Soul.
The Son = truth.

This is My beloved Son () = His Divine Human; and, as the Divine truth is from Him, it was said out of the cloud, in whom I find pleasure; hear ye Him. ( = that He is the Divine truth, or the Word. AE 594:2.) Ath 146.
Sons and daughters = Knowledges of truth and good.
Sons = affections of truth; daughters, affections of good.
They are called sons who receive truths; daughters, who receive goods.
Sons = all falsities in general.
Sons round about thy tables () = truths of good thence.
The Son = the Lord's Divine Human, (which has life in itself.) AE 401:9.
The sons who are an heritage of Jehovah () = the truths through which is intelligence. ( = those in truths from good. AE 710:13.)
Sons, in the Word, = those in truths from good.
Thou shalt see thy sons' sons () = truths of doctrine, and their multiplication to eternity.
Sons = falsities of evil.
If the Son shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed (). By the Son is meant the Lord, and also the Truth.
Sons = falsities. AE 555:20. AE 724:34. Illustrated. AE 768:24.
Sons hard in faces () = those in truths without good; abstractedly, truths without good.
Under Father, see this reference.
Son = the truth of the Church.
Sons = those in the truths of the Church. AE 768:6.
Sons and daughters = the falsities and evils of the Church.
Sons = those in falsities of doctrine; here, those in falsities.
To sacrifice sons and daughters () = to destroy the truths and goods of the Church through evil cupidities.

They shall eat the flesh of sons and daughters (); the fathers shall eat the sons, and the sons shall eat the fathers ()... Sons = the truths of the Church; and, in the opposite, its falsities. AE 724:29.
Sons = those in the affection of truth.
Sons and daughters = those in the spiritual affection of truth and good.
Sons and daughters shall fall by the sword () = that the truths and goods of the Church will perish through the falsities of evil.
Thy sons as olive plants () = truths born from the affection of truth, (through which) are produced the goods of love and charity.
Sons of a raven () = natural men, who are in darksome lumen from fallacies concerning Divine truths...
Sons = those in truths of doctrine.
Sons and daughters = truths and goods.
Sons and daughters = exterior truths and goods.
Thy sons shall come again to their own border () = that spiritual truths will come forth with those who will be of this New Church.
Sons = truths from the Lord through the Word.
Sons = the truths of the Church and of doctrine. Fully illustrated.
Sons of thunder () = truths from celestial good.
Thou art My Son, this day have I begotten thee () = the Divine Human, which also is the Son of God.
The Son = the Divine Human. AE 852:end. Ath 4.
The Son = the Divine truth.
Sons of Zion () = those in wisdom from Divine truth.
The Angels in the Third Heaven are called the Lord's sons... those in the Second, sons of the kingdom, and sons of the king.
He who seeth the Son, and believeth in Him, shall have eternal life (). To see the Son = to see the Lord in spirit.
A Son born from eternity. Refuted. Ath 78. CanonsNC 43. Trinity. 5. 4.
They think of the Son as a common man.
Holy Spirit. 1. 7. As the Father is the soul and life of the Son, and the Son is the human body of the Father... they are consubstantial, and subsist conjointly.
